title: CTXAgent - Self-Controlled Context Management of LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34425v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent harnesses keep long sessions inside the context window by compacting the history when a token threshold is crossed. We study an alternative in which the model manages its own context: it decides when to compact, what to keep and what to write as the hand-off, given two tools and one paragraph of guidance. Since earlier work found that open-weight models cannot manage their own context without scaffolding, we compare seven frontier models under identical conditions, with and without the context tools, on token cost and benchmark score, and we compare our harness with three widely used harnesses on two of these models. translated_title: CTXAgent——大语言模型智能体的自控上下文管理
translated_abstract: 智能体框架通过在超过token阈值时压缩历史记录，将长会话保持在上下文窗口内。我们研究了一种替代方案：由模型自己管理上下文——在仅给定两个工具和一段指导说明的条件下，自行决定何时压缩、保留哪些内容以及撰写何种交接信息。鉴于先前研究发现开放权重模型在没有脚手架支持的情况下无法管理自身上下文，我们在相同条件下比较了七个前沿模型在有无上下文工具时的token成本与基准得分，并在其中两个模型上将我们的框架与三个广泛使用的框架进行了对比。该基准由现有基准组合而成：编程练习、多步骤SciCode问题以及SWE-bench Pro和Terminal-Bench 4.0任务，并与植入的事实、临时观察和长期指令交错出现，全部采用确定性方式校验，会话长度为35至212轮，模拟用户在长会话中持续工作的场景。
tldr: 该论文提出CTXAgent，让大模型智能体仅凭两个工具和一段指导自主管理自身上下文——自行决定何时压缩、保留什么及交接什么——并通过由现有任务与植入事实交织、确定性校验的35-212轮长会话基准，对七个前沿模型和三个常用框架进行了系统评估。
en_tdlr: CTXAgent enables LLM agents to self-manage their context—deciding when to compact, what to keep, and what to hand off—using only two tools and a paragraph of guidance, evaluated across seven frontier models and three popular harnesses on a composite benchmark of 35–212-turn sessions with deterministically checked planted facts.
